ballots.title: Vote audit
ballots.sealed: Votes stay hidden until voting ends.
help.title: Counting rules
help.intro: We use the preference (instant runoff) method.
help.rule_majority: Whoever holds over 50% of the live papers wins.
help.rule_eliminate: If nobody does, the lowest candidate drops out and their papers move to the next preference still standing.
help.rule_ties: Lowest-place ties go against the candidate with fewer first preferences, then against the one printed lower on the paper.
help.rule_exhausted: Papers with no remaining preference are spent.
help.rule_tied: A dead heat between the final two means no winner and no announcement.
help.rule_paper: Each paper can carry one vote only.
flash.voter_at_kiosk: Someone is still voting on paper {paper}.
flash.closing: Review the numbers before ending voting.
flash.not_closing: Nothing is waiting to be ended.
flash.counted: Voting ended and the count is done. Cancelled papers: {voided}.
flash.tied: A dead heat cannot be announced.
